name: project-operations
description: Poppy is a personal Codex partner with focused skills and optional stateless housekeeping hooks from intake through verified delivery and organized closure.

interface.longDescription: Poppy preserves the user's outcome, routes one focused owner for context, intake, decisions, coordination, research, diagnosis, delivery, acceptance, assurance, learning, or Codex housekeeping, acts within explicit authority, and verifies consequential claims. Optional stateless hooks provide narrow lifecycle reminders and metadata guards.
defaultPrompt: Poppy, turn this rough idea into a recommendation, then implement the selected outcome.
Poppy, diagnose this defect and verify the fix.
Poppy, tell me what this project needs next and give me the decision-ready version.
